# PACK-REVOCATION

<!-- generated by scripts/docs/generate_system_docs.py; edit source manifests, schemas or detailed docs -->

Detailed sources: `docs/architecture/pack-admission.md`,
`tests/packs/test_governance.py`, and `tests/heavy/test_remote_routing.py`.

Direct or transitive pack revocation outranks otherwise complete evidence.
Remote image revocation rejects heavy jobs before launch. Revocation is a
stop signal for the affected capability, not a reason to silently choose a
different backend.
